bibliographic.title: Robust differential gene expression patterns in the prefrontal cortex of male mice exposed to an occupationally relevant dose of laboratory-generated wildfire smoke
bibliographic.title_raw_stored: Robust differential gene expression patterns in the prefrontal cortex of male mice exposed to an occupationally relevant dose of laboratory-generated wildfire smoke

scope_reason: The paper examines a health impact of wildfire smoke exposure (neurotoxicology) in an occupational exposure model.

scope_span.evidence_text: Here, we sought to address this by using RNA sequencing to examine transcriptomic signatures in the prefrontal cortex of male mice modeling career wildland firefighter smoke exposure.

claims.restatement: Smoke-exposed mouse prefrontal cortex showed robust gene expression changes versus filtered-air controls, with 2,862 differentially expressed genes (51.2% increased).

concept.value: gene expression profiles (prefrontal cortex, male mice)

experimental_condition.value: male Apoe-/- mice exposed to laboratory-generated wildfire smoke (target 40 mg/m3) 2 h/d, 5 d/wk for 16 wk vs filtered air

support_span.evidence_text: Mice were exposed to filtered air or simulated wildfire smoke in a 3D printed exposure chamber, which has been experimentally validated to evenly distribute particulate matter (Eden et al. 2023), for 2 h/d, 5 d/wk, for 16 wk.

evidence.evidence_text: We report robust changes in gene expression profiles between smoke-exposed samples and filtered air controls, evidenced by 2,862 differentially expressed genes (51.2% increased).

claims.note: Internal inconsistency: the results section reports 1,396 increased and 1,466 decreased (1,396/2,862 = 48.8%), and a figure caption states the reverse; recorded as stated in the abstract.

claims.restatement: Differentially expressed genes were enriched in pathways related to synaptic transmission, neuroplasticity, blood-brain barrier integrity and neurotransmitter metabolism.

concept.value: functional pathways of differentially expressed genes

relation_or_direction.value: enriched for synaptic transmission, neuroplasticity, BBB integrity, neurotransmitter metabolism

evidence.evidence_text: We further characterized the functional relevance of these genes highlighting enriched pathways related to synaptic transmission, neuroplasticity, blood-brain barrier integrity, and neurotransmitter metabolism.

rejected_or_ambiguous.evidence_text: Exposure to wildfire smoke has been recently associated with cognitive dysfunction, including a significantly heightened risk of AD dementia in a human epidemiologic cohort when compared with other air pollutants (Zhang et al. 2023).
rejected_or_ambiguous.reason: Cited background; not promoted to keep claims to this study.
